description: Pixel age from Present() submission to usable detections (boxes, classes, scores after NMS) from YOLO11n on the RTX 4060 via ONNX Runtime 1.30 CUDA, with the build/scenes/default scene panning under the frame-ID marker. Capture is on the Intel iGPU, so every GPU path crosses adapters. Medians across 3 passes of 8 s per path; every path verified first. Processes pinned to logical processors 2-15 (mask 0xfffc, RAPIDSHOT_BENCH_EXCLUDE_CPUS=0,1), as the dGPU inference recording was.
machine: Machine B, MUX hybrid: Intel UHD capture, RTX 4060 Laptop CUDA, 2560x1600 at 165 Hz
